niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel calm, polished, and intentionally structured: light or softly muted surfaces, clear hierarchy, tidy modular grouping or integrated list structure, generous spacing, complete/populated content, restrained interface chrome, and muted but expressive accent color. They also respond well to modern premium styling when it remains organized and not noisy.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that feel fully populated, resolved, and functionally complete, with visible items and balanced use of space rather than sparse or unfinished layouts.
Prefers strong, readable hierarchy with clearly separated sections, labeled groupings, and organized information architecture that makes scanning easy.
Prefers open whitespace, generous padding, and an airy vertical rhythm over cramped stacking and heavy visual compression.
Prefers distraction-free compositions with fewer competing controls, less decorative clutter, and restrained interface chrome.
Prefers muted, varied, often pastel or gentle multicolor accents that give items personality without harsh contrast or blunt primary-color emphasis.
Prefers consistent row patterns, uniform component behavior, crisp boundaries, and an overall finished, coherent visual system.
Prefers a calm, modern, polished aesthetic that feels contemporary and refined rather than generic, overly utilitarian, or template-like.
